slides.headline: MUSK BET $100M ON ROCKETS. THREE EXPLODED. THE FOURTH FLEW.

caption:
The company that nearly went bankrupt after three failed rockets in 2008 just put the first Starlink V3 satellites into orbit.

In 2002, Musk put $100M of his own PayPal money into a rocket company nobody believed in. Three launches failed, in 2006, 2007, and 2008. He had enough left for one final attempt. On September 28, 2008, the fourth Falcon 1 became the first rocket a private company had ever sent to orbit. By year's end, NASA handed SpaceX a $1.6 billion contract. Send this to someone who's on their second or third failure right now.

Before SpaceX, only governments launched satellites. Musk put private money in, absorbed three straight failures, and refused to quit. SpaceX has since launched over 300 missions and is now worth more than $200 billion.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
